blockbuilder-explorer.visual_critic_note: Cohesive dark-theme dashboard with intentional CSS variable system, consistent blue accent, and clear typographic hierarchy across panels — elevated by the multi-view layout, but the network graph is too dense to read individual nodes and the thumbnail grid feels cramped at rendered size.
blockbuilder-explorer.encoding_integrity_note: All circle encodings use scaleSqrt (correct area scaling), bar chart baseline starts at 0, domains are data-driven via d3.extent/d3.max throughout, and fixed axes (hue 0–360, lightness 0–100) are semantically appropriate rather than deceptive.
blockbuilder-explorer.stress_test_note: RAF dirty-flag coalescing is correctly implemented, but the LIST and THUMBS updaters do full innerHTML replacement (up to 200–500 DOM nodes) inside every RAF callback during brush drag, making each frame expensive; no stale closures, no transitions to interrupt, no infinite loops, and pointer events unify mouse/touch correctly.
blockbuilder-explorer.cognitive_load_note: Four linked crossfilter views (timeline brush, dense API co-occurrence network, color scatter, thumbnail wall) update simultaneously and are each readable in isolation, but the hairball network — many nodes with high edge density and no visible clustering — is the dominant cognitive risk, and the thumbnail wall adds a third dense information layer that competes for attention.
